review.notes: Full review. Previous R01 and R02 repaired. Gate rerun: every scanner 0, OK (worker gate.md: build=0); depcheck 245 roadmaps, 2243 edges, 0 problems; no change outside the folder. Suggested.lean elaborates with seven sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe (simp, infer_instance, rfl, exact?, aesop) closes none; eleven elaborated types match the README. Seeded sample of fifteen targets (0.4, 0.6, 2.2, 2.10, 2.11, 3.1, 3.4, 3.9, 5.6, 5.7, 5.10, 6.5, 7.4, 8.1, 8.2) computed and checked against SGA 4 XVIII, BBD, Bhatt-Scholze, Scholze's diamonds manuscript, Varshavsky (2007 and arXiv v3 of the local-terms paper), de Cataldo-Migliorini, Zhu and Milne: 84 locators, one page range off by one. No statement found false. P2: curve Euler-Poincare formula also owned by FourierDeligneTransform 2.7 (earlier in the merge order) and not cited; bettiGrowthInEtaleTowers has no consumer, its only use being a proof assigned to AutomorphicLFunctionsAndLocalFactors AL.3.10.10; the statement of the flat trace in 0.4 translates SGA 4 XVIII Theoreme 2.9 clause by clause. P3: unnamed scope deferrals (main's SchemeAndStackFoundations names this roadmap for absolute and Brauer purity), slug and code-span residue of the label repair, 25 duplicated Checks, six targets without Needs lines, one locator and two uncited books, two reference keys for one paper. Two source issues recorded (Varshavsky local-terms Lemma 5.1, Zhu A.3.1). Paywalled texts (Jantzen, Huber, Dimca, Liu-Tian-Xiao-Zhang-Zhu) and the Compositio version of record were not read.
